svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: How a change is delivered in Project Aether. The operator pushes to main on GitHub, and Renovate opens weekly pull requests. GitHub Actions runs pre-commit, kubeconform, Helm values lint, promtool and a SOPS check. GitHub sends a signed webhook through Cloudflare and the edge VM's outbound tunnel to ArgoCD on the cluster, which refreshes only the apps whose paths changed. The repo server fetches Git, and KSOPS decrypts secrets inside it with the local age key. Secrets are encrypted for two keys, a local age key and a Cloud KMS key. Ansible for hosts and Terraform for machines are applied by hand.
svg.text: A push is checked, then ArgoCD applies only what changed. Secrets stay encrypted in Git.
